title: Columbia, MO — Cost of Living, Housing & Relocation Guide [2026]
description: Complete guide to Columbia, MO: cost of living, home prices, neighborhoods, remote work readiness, and relocation tips.
content:
Overview

Columbia is a city in MO with a population of 125,000. College town with the University of Missouri, a vibrant arts scene, and The District. Housing costs are close to the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 5a growing zone supports Cool — many vegetables, some fruit trees. A large share of residents hold a bachelor’s degree or higher. The population skews young, with a median age of 29.2.
